label: State Formation
description: Development of durable political institutions and territorial governance.

label: Imperial Overstretch
description: Empires expanding beyond sustainable administrative, fiscal, or military capacity.

label: Trade-Network Expansion
description: Growth and integration of long-distance commercial routes and exchange systems.

label: Bureaucratic Centralization
description: Consolidation of governance through stronger administrative institutions and state capacity.

label: Religious Diffusion
description: Spread of religious ideas, institutions, and practices across regions and cultures.

label: Succession Crisis
description: Instability triggered by contested political succession or leadership transitions.

label: Technological Diffusion
description: Transmission and adoption of technologies across societies and economic systems.

label: Frontier Expansion
description: Territorial expansion into borderlands through settlement, conquest, or migration.

label: Urbanization
description: Population concentration in cities with related social and economic transformation.

label: Military Reform
description: Institutional or technological modernization of military organization and strategy.

label: Legitimacy Crisis
description: Erosion or contestation of perceived political authority and right to rule.
